text: dsh-logtimeline（DSH 工具插件）：用中文自然语言时间查询本地日志。它在 DSH 的工具注册表提供 log_query，调用随包提供的 Python 日志查询程序解析时间范围并筛选日志。主要功能包括中文日期和相对时间解析、按文件或目录查询、按时间和级别统计匹配结果，并以结构化结果返回。适合需要快速定位某个时段日志的 DSH 用户。使用前需要 Python 3.9+；不需要额外密钥配置。

dsh-logtimeline adds a DSH tool for querying local logs with Chinese time expressions. log_query resolves a time range, filters files or directories, and returns matching lines and severity counts. It is useful for finding logs from a particular period. Requires Python 3.9+; no API key is needed.
想按“昨天下午”这样的时间说法查本地日志
帮我找出某个时间段的 ERROR 和 WARN 日志
我不想手动写 grep 和时间戳过滤，能直接查日志吗
让 DSH 根据中文时间范围筛选日志文件并统计级别
怎么递归搜索目录里的日志并限制返回行数
Find matching local log lines for a Chinese time expression
Search local logs for a chosen time window and summarize severity counts
dsh-logtimeline 的功能「中文时间范围」：解析中文自然语言时间描述并查询对应时间窗口的日志，返回起止时间和解析置信度。通过 DSH 的 log_query 工具调用，输入时间描述及文件或目录。。
dsh-logtimeline 的功能「文件或目录筛选」：按给定日志文件列表或目录递归扫描，并可指定目录模式的文件名 glob。调用 log_query 时传入 files 或 dir。。
dsh-logtimeline 的功能「行数与级别统计」：返回匹配行、总命中数、截断状态以及 ERROR、WARN、INFO 等级别统计；可用 max_lines 限制返回行数或设为 0 仅统计。。
dsh-logtimeline 的功能「Python 启动回退」：使用配置的 Python 命令运行随包附带的查询脚本；默认命令不可启动时尝试 python3 和 Windows py -3。。
排查故障时，能按具体日期和时间段列出相关日志吗

dsh-logtimeline README · Introduction：---

Ask 「昨天下午」「3小时前」「凌晨12点」「上周三 14:00-15:00」 — get the matching log lines, the resolved time range, and ERROR/WARN/INFO level stats. **Fully offline. Logs never leave the machine.**

dsh-logtimeline README · Why：Coding agents constantly need to answer *"what happened around 3pm yesterday?"*. Generic log tools make you hand-write `grep` pipelines and timestamp math. `log_query` resolves the fuzzy Chinese time expression for you and returns **structured, machine-readable matches** the agent can reason over directly — no parsing prose out of terminal output.

dsh-logtimeline README · Features：| | |
|---|---|
| 🕐 **Chinese time parsing** | Absolute dates (`2026-07-03`, `7月3日 09:15`), relative (`3小时前`, `昨天`, `上周三`), fuzzy windows (`下午`, `凌晨`), hour ranges (`14:00-15:00`) — each with a confidence score |
| 📄 **Multi-format logs** | Auto-detected timestamp formats, UTF-8/GBK encoding fallback, streaming filter (no full-file load, ~2.4s per 300k lines) |
| 🔒 **Offline by default** | Zero third-party Python dependencies; log contents never leave the machine |
| 🧩 **Structured output** | Canonical JSON (`time_range`, `filter`, `lines`, `stats`) rendered as readable text for the model, spill-safe under the harness's 50KB inline budget |

dsh-logtimeline README · Install：**Prerequisites**: a dsh profile (`web` or `headless`) + **Python 3.9+** on the machine (on Windows, the `py` launcher is auto-detected when `python` is missing).

**Local / development** (from a checkout):

```sh
git clone https://github.com/anyuer678/dsh-logtimeline.git
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-logtimeline
```

dsh-logtimeline README · Install：**Community install** — once listed in [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin), install via the plugin market (GitHub-only plugins are supported):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket

dsh-logtimeline README · Parameters：| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `time_text` | string **(required)** | Chinese natural-language time, e.g. 「昨天下午」「3小时前」 |
| `files` | string[] | Log file paths (absolute or workspace-relative) |
| `dir` | string | Directory to scan recursively |
| `pattern` | string | Glob when `dir` is set (default `*.log`) |
| `max_lines` | number | Max lines returned (default 500; `0` = stats only; capped at 5000) |
| `since` | string | RFC3339 absolute-time fallback when `time_text` fails to parse |
| `timezone` | string | IANA timezone name, e.g. `Asia/Shanghai` |
dsh-logtimeline README · Parameters：The tool runs in **offline mode by default**: it filters precisely (its unique value), and leaves root-cause reasoning to the agent itself.

dsh-logtimeline README · Architecture：```
src/query.ts      Core logic: subprocess → vendored lq.py --json → parse (framework-free, testable)
src/runtime.ts    DSH assembly: registers log_query via defineTool (ctx.tools)
src/config.ts     Plugin config (pythonBin, timeoutMs)
python/           Vendored LogTimeline CLI (GPL-3.0, see python/VENDORED.md)

dsh-logtimeline README · Architecture：The plugin shells out to a vendored copy of the [LogTimeline](https://github.com/anyuer678/logtimeline) Python CLI (`python/lq.py --json --no-llm`), so the battle-tested parsing/filtering logic stays untouched. Vendoring changes are minimal and documented in `python/VENDORED.md`.

dsh-logtimeline README · Development：```sh
npm install --legacy-peer-deps   # peer deps are provided by the DSH host runtime
npm run typecheck
npm run test                     # integration tests: real vendored Python + host-assembly smoke
npm run build

dsh-logtimeline README · Development：`tests/query.test.ts` runs the real vendored Python CLI against fixture logs; `tests/host.test.ts` loads the built plugin (`lib/`) into a minimal Cordis container, applies it, and validates the canonical value against the `output.schema` contract. Peer packages (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`, pinned to the `0.1.0-rc.6` line) are installed as devDependencies so the runtime import chain resolves outside a DSH host.

dsh-logtimeline README · Security & Privacy：- **No key handling**: the plugin reads no API keys, stores no credentials, and makes no outbound calls — log analysis is 100% local
- **No log exfiltration**: log lines are returned to the agent (the model) as tool results, never sent anywhere else
- **Path scoping**: only the paths the model passes (via `files`/`dir`) are read; the tool is read-only, it never writes or deletes log files
- **Output hygiene**: control characters / ANSI escapes in log lines are stripped from rendered output

dsh-logtimeline README · Ecosystem：dsh-logtimeline ships a thin MCP stdio wrapper — `python/mcp_server.py` (requires `pip install mcp`), exposing two tools: `log_query` (Chinese natural-language time + log files → structured JSON) and `parse_time` (time-range resolution only). **Verified end-to-end on 2026-10-10**: registered into [lumen](https://github.com/anyuer678/lumen) (24/7 agent runtime with built-in MCP registration) via `POST /v1/mcp/servers` → `POST /v1/mcp/servers/dsh-logtimeline/test` → `{"status":"ok"}`; a real `log_query("10分钟前")` call over MCP returned the resolved time range, matched lines and level stats.
